content.prompt:
For each of the following, determine if the sets are disjoint or not disjoint.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=\{1,2,3,4,5\}\\B&=\{x\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }x^2>25\}\end{aligned}$$

answer.worked: For every $x\in A$, $x^2\leq25$. No member satisfies the strict condition $x^2>25$, so $A\cap B=\varnothing$.
